QuestInfo.name: Destructive Creation
QuestInfo.0: What does destructive creation mean? Ask Grendel the Really Old.
QuestInfo.1: #bDouble-click on the #i2430873# Vampiric Lantern#k to get to the #m102020300# and #beliminate 50 Axe Stumps#k. #bDouble-click on the Vampiric Lantern#k to return when all's said and done.
QuestInfo.2: Only eyes that see darkness remain. Talk to Grendel the Really Old when you're ready.

0.0: We're halfway done, and I think I know what destructive creation and eyes that see darkness are.\r\n#L0##bImpressive! You are as wise as you are aged.#l\n#k
0.1: You flatterer! Now, let me explain what destructive creation is.

yes.0: There are mountainous areas that are very dry in Perion, on the northeast side of Victoria Island. The monsters there, called Axe Stumps, are part trees but still have the axe that felled them embedded in them. They embody that contradictory meaning in their grim appearance.
yes.1: #bDouble-click the Vampiric Lantern#k to go to the Big Rocky Road and eliminate #b50 Axe Stumps#k.

no.0: Did something come up? Return to me when you're ready.

1.0: So, what did you think of the Axe Stumps?\r\n#L0##bAs you said, they were very strange. Kind of tragic, carrying around the item that both destroyed and created them.#l\n#k
1.1: I see. I will record what you just said, because it sounded terribly clever. Well done.

yes.0: It's time for the final paradox. Tell me when you're ready.

mob.0: Nature always wants to test the limits of humans. Don't lose yourself in Perion's rough winds. Eliminate 50 Axe Stumps and use the #i2430873# Vampiric Lantern.
